title: Example arguments for sqlDT
text: can use various SQL queries manipulate data displaying DataTable. data.frame used query denoted “?” query. full list supported SQL statements, see Alasql GitHub page Supported SQL statements. full list supported SQL keywords, see AlaSQL GitHub page SQL Compatability. example use cases sqlDT function:

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT SepalLength, SepalWidth, Species FROM ?")

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT SepalLength AS SL, SepalWidth AS `Sepal Width` FROM ?")

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT Species, AVG(SepalLength) AS Avg_SepalLength FROM ? GROUP BY Species")

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT * FROM ? ORDER BY SepalLength DESC")

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
text: result query returned using DataTables javascript library. sqlDT function also allows customise DataTable using various options. full list customisations available, see DataTables documentation Options. example use cases sqlDT function:

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT * FROM ?", options = list(searching = TRUE))

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT * FROM ?", options = list(columnDefs = list(list(visible = FALSE, targets = c(2,3)))))

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT * FROM ?", options = list(dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print')))

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT * FROM ?", options = list(scrollY = '200px', scrollCollapse = TRUE, paging = FALSE))

title: Example arguments for sqlDT
code: sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT * FROM ?", options = list(order = list(list(0, 'desc'))))

title: Display a DataTable from a SQL Query with Crosstalk Support
text: basic example shows create simple sqlDT table: See full documentation https://pli9.github.io/sqlDT/.
code: library(sqlDT) ## basic example code data_iris <- iris names(data_iris) <- c("SepalLength", "SepalWidth", "PetalLength", "PetalWidth", "Species") sqlDT(data_iris, query = "SELECT Species, round(sum(SepalLength)/count(*), 2) as Average_Sepal_Length FROM ? GROUP BY Species")
